# Frequently Asked Questions

### General

### Why does the parking gate not work?

There could be a few reasons for this:

  1. Parking gates usually work, but are sometimes damaged by individual parkers seeking to obtain free privileges.

  2. You may not be authorized to park in that specific lot at that time. Signs are posted at all gated lots to indicate the hours each type of permit/visitor can access the lot. If a gate is malfunctioning (example: gate opens and grants you access), posted signage regulations still apply.

  3. When approaching the gate, your vehicle is either too far away from the antenna, or, you approached too fast and the antenna did not have enough time to respond to the radio wave. Try backing up past the antenna, pause, and try again.

  4. Our modernized gating system is programmed to prevent "permit pass backs." The system will expect one in and one out each time you utilize an authorized zone. You cannot let others in and out with your permit or the system will prevent further gate operations.




Your Western ONECard is connected to your permit hang tag. If you have trouble with your hang tag not reading at the gate, you may be able to work the gate by "tapping" your Western ONECard at the podium where indicated.

_Our gate intercom service is answered 24/7 to assist you._

### Can I park without a permit in a lot that has its parking gate up or if there is no gate?

Parking gates are ususally working, but are sometimes damaged by individual parkers seeking to obtain free privileges. We maintain the gates on a daily basis, and, if parking is intended to be open for the day, we will display a sign to that effect. Please observe the permanent posted signage which reflects the real times and uses of the lots. An open parking gate or ungated lot (like Elborn, Siebens Drake, or Support Services lot) does not constitute an invitation to park for free.

### Where can I park overnight if I don't have a permit?

Short term visitor parking is available in various locations around campus. Please see our [Visitor Parking Information](../find/visitor/index.html) page for details.

The best lot for overnight visitor parking is usually the Huron Flats lot (subject to change due to special events). Visitors can pull a ticket to enter the lot and pay by credit card on exit to a daily maximum rate of $12.00. Contact the [Parking Office](contact_us.html) by phone, email, or in person for more information.

### How safe is it on campus when I walk to my vehicle at night?

The campus is very safe, and there are a number of safety features in place in the parking lots (emergency phones, lighting, security cameras). [Western Foot Patrol ](http://www.uwo.ca/footpatrol/)offers a visible presence in the lots as well as while on patrol. You may also check out the [Work Safe Program](http://www.uwo.ca/police/personal_safety/work_safe_program.html) operated by [Western Special Constable Service](https://www.uwo.ca/police/) and [Western Foot Patrol](https://www.uwo.ca/footpatrol/).

### What do I do if I need to unload something and need to park close to a building?

You should obtain a 30 minute Loading Zone Permit from the office that you are visiting, or pay to park in a visitor space close to the building.

### Do I have to pay the Pay and Display/Honk Mobile spaces in the evening? 

All Pay and Display and Honk Mobile areas are payable 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

### What do I do if there is a flood advisory?

The Medway (including the Elgin Hall metered spaces) and Talbot lots are subject to flooding during extreme weather conditions. In order to avoid damage to your vehicle, it may be necessary to move your vehicles out of these areas on short notice. When the threat of flooding exists, instructions to move your vehicle will be communicated through the [Western Homepage](http://uwo.ca/index.html) and [Weather Update page](http://uwo.ca/weather.html). Users of these lots are required to monitor [Western's Weather Update](http://uwo.ca/weather.html) page during periods of extreme weather.

As with all parking lots, Western shall not be responsible for any loss, injury, or damage to persons/vehicles, including contents, however caused.

### Where can I park when going to the Recreation Centre?

The Alumni-Thompson lot is not available for Campus Recreaction parking when the parking kiosk is attended, unless you pay the daily rate as posted.

**Employees and Students:**  
Those with perimeter (grey) and core (orange) permits must park in the South Valley Lot, Huron Flats Lot, and Althouse Lot. Students with the non-reserved (green) permit must park at the Huron Flats lot and Althouse lot. All permits are valid in all of these lots after 4 pm on weekdays, all day on weekends, and on statutory holidays.

**Alumni and General Public:  
**[Visitor parking](https://www.uwo.ca/parking/find/visitor/index.html) options can be found on campus.

### Where can I park for free?

There is no free parking on campus during the day, Monday to Friday. There is complimentary parking available in some designated lots on weekends from Friday at 5 pm until Sunday evening. Lot availability is subject to change. Parkers should obey posted signage.

Elborn lot - free weeknights from 4:00 pm - 7:00 am, unmarked spaces only.

Siebens Drake lot and Upper Heating Lots - free weeknights from 7:00 pm - 7:00 am.

Please see the [Parking Map](../find/map.html) for weekend complimentary parking.

### About Your Parking Account

### Do I need to change my address even if the Registrars Office has my current address?

Yes, you need to change/update your address both at Parking as well as the Office of the Registrar.

### What is LPR? How can I add my vehicle plate information to my Parking Account?

LPR, License Plate Recognition technology uses optical character recognition to automatically read license plate characters. Western will be operating mobile LPR, which uses vehicle-mounted cameras to verify plates in all campus lots.

If you use Western's permit lots, you'll need to ensure your Parking Account is up to date with accurate information and that your vehicle plates are linked to your permit. Instructions for managing vehicles on your account are located here: [MANAGE PLATES TIED TO YOUR PERMIT](../modernization/license_plate_recognition_lpr.html)

Please call the Parking Office at 519-661-3973 if you have any questions or concerns about LPR and/or how to add vehicle plates to your permit - we're always here to help!

### About Infractions

### Why did my car get a citation and the three beside me didn't? 

Sometimes vehicles have obtained permission in advance to park in restricted areas. As the enforcement process is computerized, these vehicles may or may not be displaying special permits. It also may be that enforcement personnel passed through the area prior to the noted individuals illegitimate parking activities.

### What do I do if I get an infraction?

You have two options:

  1. [Appeal within 14 days](../infractions/appeals/index.html)
  2. [Pay your infraction within 14 days](../infractions/pay.html)



**Please do not ignore a parking ticket!**  
Accounts with unpaid fines run the risk of the following actions: parking privileges revoked, academic records sealed, vehicles towed, and/or account balance transfered to a collection agency. This is a fully automated process, and we suggest you deal with these problems promptly to avoid unnecessary charges.

### About Accessibility

### How do I apply for an accessible permit?

You can request an accessible parking permit when you apply for a permit [based on your status on campus](../permits/index.html). Please visit our [Accessible Permit](../permits/accessible.html) page to learn about what you need in order to qualify for an accessible Western parking permit.

### What if all the accessible spaces are taken and I have an accessible permit? 

You will have to park in another lot. If you are unable to do this, we suggest you park in any non-reserved space.

### About Visitors and Event Parking

### Where can visitors park during the day?

Please see our [Visitor Parking](../find/visitor/index.html) section of the site.

### How do I make parking arrangements for a special event? 

Please see the [Special Event Parking](../services/dept_host/special_events.html) page.

### Where can my friend park if (s)he comes to visit me at my residence on the weekend?

[Complimentary weekend parking](../find/summer_evening_weekend.html) is strategically located around campus. Please see the [Parking Map](../find/map.html) for details.

### About Parking Permits

### What is the difference between a reserved and a non-reserved permit?

**Reserved:**  
There are a limited number of reserved parking spaces on campus. The reserved parking guarentees a parking space in the reserved section of the specific lot chosen by the permit holder. Parking in a reserved section is authorized only for the vehicle(s) for which the reserved permit has been issued. Reserved permits are also valid in the non-reserved sections of any other lot within the same zone. Holders of reserved permits may park in any space within the reserved section of their selected lot.

**Non-Reserved:**  
Spaces are available on a first-come first-serve basis. Non-reserved permit holders are guaranteed a space within the zone (orange, grey, or green) of the permit they purchase. However, the non-reserved permit does NOT guarentee a parking space in a specific lot. If your lot of choice is full, you are expected to move to the next nearest lot within your zone.

### Can I park at affiliated schools (Kings, Huron) with my Western parking pass? 

Each school has their own parking pass. Your parking pass is valid only at the campus where you purchased it. Please see the [affiliate parking page](../find/affiliate.html) for information about parking at Western's affiliated schools.

### Where do I place my hang tag in my vehicle?

Generally, the best position for the hang tag to active the gate mechanism is hanging from the rear-view mirror. Alternatively, you could also position the hang tag on the inside of the windshield, on the driver's side of the dashboard. The hang tag should be facing out so that enforcement staff can clearly see the permit number when monitoring parking lots. Please remove the hang tag from your rear-view mirror if it inhibits visibility when the vehicle is in motion.

### How does the hang tag work?

Approach the parking gate slowly; the gates are mechanical and may require a second or two to open. Drive at a slow speed within about 3 feet of the antenna.

The antenna is mounted on the pole at the foot of the island. When you get within 10 feet of the antenna, your hang tag will reflect a low frequency radio wave specific to your permit and the gate will open.

Do not tailgate; the vehicle ahead of you may obstruct the radio frequency path between your device and the antenna.

### Is my parking permit refundable?

Permit refunds can be issued for the early return of student permits within certain time restrictions. You must return your hang tag in order for the refund to be accepted on a prorated basis for the remaining full months not used. Details and refund date cut-off information is located on the [Student Permits](../permits/students/index.html) page.

### Glossary of Terms

### General

**Contractor vehicles** \- special parking areas are assigned to Contractors by Western Parking and Visitor Services. Contractors are prohibited from all other areas.

**Commercial vehicles** (Service Reps. Etc.) - Commercial firms may use the parking facilities assigned to visitors (i.e., visitor lots, meters) and pay the stated rate. Monthly and annual contractor permits are also available.

**Core Lot** \- smaller lot situated in the campus core.

**Medical and Dental Clinicians** \- The permits for Medical and Dental Clinicians will be provided in accordance with lists supplied by the Deans' Offices and will be issued by the Manager of Parking & Visitor Services.

**Perimeter Lot** \- lot situated in the campus periphery.

**Reserved Parking** \- A limited number of reserved spaces in Core or Perimeter lots may be available to Employee and Students. Parking in a reserved section is authorized only for the vehicle(s) for which the reserved permit has been issued. Reserved permits are only valid in the lot requested. Reserved spaces cannot be 'loaned' to another person and/or vehicle. Holders of reserved permits may park in any space within the reserved section of their selected lot. Reserved permits are not oversubscribed. A premium rate is charged for this service.

**Retirees** \- Retired members of UWO Faculty and Staff may apply for complimentary visitor area parking (depending on space availability).

**Loading Zone permits** \- 30 minute loading zone permits may be obtained through any department or administrative unit.

**Student Apartment permits** \- Parking permits may be obtained from Student Housing. Student Apartment permits are not valid on main campus. All other Rules and Regulations apply.

**Visitor Lot** \- lot available to university visitors only.

### Violations and Penalties

19.01 Definitions: Except where specifically indicated, the definitions prescribed in the Highway Traffic Act R.S.O. 1980, Chapter 198, as amended shall apply.

(a) For the purpose of identifying violations the following definitions apply:

**Bikeway** means any path, roadway or portion thereof or any area improved for the convenience of bicycles and marked as such by official signs.

**Date of Violation** means the date the violation occurred as designated on the violation ticket.

**Gate Arm Breakage** means breaking of a gate arm by any person except under circumstances when a malfunction prevents a gate arm from rising to permit a vehicle from exiting a lot in which it is authorized to park.

**Operating** means having the care or control of a vehicle

**Parking** \- when prohibited, means the standing of a vehicle, whether occupied or not, except when standing temporarily for the purpose of and while actually engaged in loading or unloading merchandise or passengers.

**Parking Lot** means the entire driving and parking area within the entrance gates of the parking lot and any area designated as a parking area by official signs.

**Parking Year** means the parking term as determined by the Parking and Traffic regulations.

**Person** means an individual, partnership, unincorporated association or any incorporated entity. 

**Roadway** includes a highway as defined by the Highway Traffic Act, as well as every traveled portion of space on Campus which is open to the public as a matter of right or by invitation, for the purpose of vehicular traffic. The roadway is all areas exclusive of designated parking spots, landscaped areas, walkways, loading zones, fire lanes, and the like.

**Reserved Parking** section means a parking area reserved for designated vehicles within parking lots.

**Service Vehicle** means any vehicle engaged in the servicing, repair of maintenance of University facilities, equipment or grounds.

**Stopping** \- means the halting of a vehicle, even momentarily, whether occupied or not, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with the directions of a police officer or of a traffic control sign or signal.

**Unauthorized Entry** to a lot means entering a parking lot through other than the proper entrance and/or by using other than the issued access device or the stated coin fee or improper use of access devices, decals, passes or entering a lot by following close to another vehicle. A gate "MISSING" or in the "UP" position does not authorize entry.

**University Special Constable** means any University Police Officer employed by Western Special Constable Service to carry out the provisions of these regulations.

**Vehicle** includes any mechanized mode of transportation.

**Vehicle Permit** includes any identification discs, decals or passes.

**Walkway** means any sidewalk, path or portion of roadway intended for use by pedestrians or as specifically designated.

# Manage Parking Account

  


If you have purchased a Western Parking permit in the past, you will already have an online account with Parking & Visitor Services. Log in to your account to:

  * Pay Infractions
  * Update your addresses
  * Add vehicles to your account

# Accessible Parking on Campus

### Accessible Western Parking Permit

Members of the University Community with long term or temporary physical disabilities may apply for access to all areas designated with the recognized international symbol. [Rates ](../permits/accessible.html) for an Accessible Western Parking Permit are equivalent to the Perimeter Non-Reserved fees specific to your status on campus. If you require a Western Accessible Permit, please send an email to [wparking@uwo.ca](mailto:wparking@uwo.ca and we'll) and we'll get you set up with the appropriate permit. [](mailto:wparking@uwo.ca and we'll)

### Where can I park if I don't have an Accessible Western Parking Permit?

Visitors who require accessible parking are granted access to all [Pay and Display and Honk Mobile zones](visitor/metered.html) on campus. Please note, parking must be paid when displaying an [Ontario Ministry of Transportation Accessible Parking Permit](http://www.ontario.ca/Accessible%20parking%20permit).

### Accessibility Map

Western’s [Campus Accessibility Map](https://accessibility.uwo.ca/doc/floorplan/campus.pdf) may be of assistance in locating accessible routes between buildings on campus.

# Affiliate Parking

  


* * *

#### [**Huron University College**](https://huronu.ca/parking/)

Parking is available to purchase in the "Student/Visitor" lot for all Huron University College students on a first come/first served basis beginning in June. Permits are valid from September 1 to August 31 annually.

* * *

#### [**Kings University College**](http://www.kings.uwo.ca/current-students/money-matters/parking-transportation/parking-services/)

There are [six parking lots](http://www.kings.uwo.ca/kings/assets/File/maps/CampusSite.pdf "See Map") on the King’s University College Campus. A limited number of guaranteed parking spots are available for purchase by students. Please make inquiries through the [Student Financial Services Office](http://www.kings.uwo.ca/about-kings/who-we-are/administrative-departments/finance/student-financial-services/).

# Campus Recreation & Tennis Parking

### [Campus Recreation](http://www.uwo.ca/campusrec/)

Parking permits specific to patrons of the Western Student Recreation Centre (WSRC) will no longer be available. Patrons of WSRC and/or the Thompson Recreation and Athletic Centre (TRAC) who do not have a Western parking permit should use short-term visitor paid parking. The closest visitor parking to the Recreation Centre is at the [Huron Flats Lot](map.html); payment is by Honk Mobile (Zone 1971). The Huron Flats Lot as well as the Elborn Lot may offer some complimentary parking evenings/weekends. See [Visitor Parking Information](visitor/index.html) for lot locations and rates.

### [Tennis Courts](http://universitytenniscentre.com)

Tennis parking is purchased directly through the tennis club with a paid membership. This permit is not issued on a Western staff/student basis. Permits are only valid in the Talbot Pay and Display Area and the Medway Student parking lot.

# Find Parking

Parking & Visitor Services strives to provide safe and convenient parking for the campus community - from first-time visitors to those who call Western their second home. Please [contact us](../about/contact_us.html) with any parking-related questions.

### Parking Facts & Tips

  * Permits are not transferable.
  * Pay & Display receipts must be displayed face-up on the driver's side of dashboard and the vehicle plate information on the ticket must match the vehicle in which it is displayed in order to be valid.
  * Hang Tags should be displayed on the rear view mirror when parking in ungated lots such as Elborn, Upper Heating, Westminster and Siebens lots. Enforcement staff must be able to clearly see the permit number.
  * Ensure your Parking Account is up to date and that your vehicle plates are linked to your permit. Instructions for managing vehicles on your account are located here: [MANAGE PLATES TIED TO YOUR PERMIT](../modernization/license_plate_recognition_lpr.html).
  * Park in designated areas only. Be sure to read the signs carefully to ensure you are parking in an appropriate space.
  * Please ensure that your vehicle is parked between the yellow lines.
  * Do not park in or block fire routes, bus stops, buildings or walkway entrances. Do not drive in restricted areas.
  * If all spaces are full in the lot, please move to the next available lot within your authorized zone.
  * Each affiliated college has their own parking pass. Your parking pass is valid only at the campus where you purchased it.
  * Bicycle Lockers are located throughout campus. Contact the [Parking Office](../about/contact_us.html) for more information.
  * A valid Accessible Parking Permit is required to park in an accessible space. Please note meters must be paid when displaying a MTO Accessible Parking Permit.

# Western Parking Map

Reference the parking map and see the selections below to get quick information about parking lot rates and permit requirements.

Other map features include:

  * Barrier-free metered parking
  * Motorcycle parking
  * Traffic light intersections



  * #### [Download Parking Map (PDF)](Parking_August_2025.pdf)




  


The rate for visitor parking on campus is $1.50 per half hour but daily maximum rates, if any, vary by lot. **Payment is by credit card at all locations (No tap/debit) with coin accepted at Pay and Display locations only.** Please see below for parking rates and visitor access to lots.

Helpful advice for parking on campus: Do not park in reserved spaces, hashlined areas, or fire zones.

### Althouse Lot (Lot H) - Employee and Student Permit Lots

**Location:** west side of Western Road, south of Sarnia Road at Althouse College.

**Type of Permit Required:**

Student Lot _:_  
All active Western permits.

Employee Lot _:_  
Active employee permits any time. Student permits are permitted M - F after 4 pm until 7 am.

**Employee lot visitor entry:** Monday - Thursday, 4 pm - 7 am - $1.50 per half hour to $18 daily maximum.

**Student lot visitor entry:** Visitor parking at any time, payment with Honk Mobile only, $1.50 per half hour to $12 maximum.

**Weekends:** Parking is complimentary except when special event rates apply.

**Paystation :** Located in the front of the building for short term visits ($1.50 per half hour). No daily maximum.

### Alumni/Thompson (Lot M) - Visitor Lot

**Location:** off Lambton Drive, near Alumni Hall and Thompson Recreation and Athletic Centre.

**Visitor parking:** Rate is $1.50 per half hour.

**Weekend parking:** Complimentary except when special event rates apply.

**Helpful advice:** Visitors to the Western Student Recreation Centre pay to park per standard visitor rates.

### Ausable Hall - Residence Parking

**Location:** north of Ausauble and Beaver Hall residence.

**Type of permit required:** Department of Housing issues appropriate permit type.

**Helpful advice:** Do not park in posted Fire Routes.

### Bayfield Hall (D) - Student Lot

**Location:** north of Bayfield Hall residence.

**Type of permit required:** All active Western parking permits.

**Student lot visitor entry:** Visitor parking at any time, payment with Honk Mobile only, $1.50 per half hour to $12 maximum.

**Helpful advice:** Do not park in posted Fire Routes.

### Clare Hall (Lot O) - Student Lot

**Location:** Behind Clare Hall.

**Type of permit required:** Studemt and Employee permits allowed to park at anytime.

**Visitor parking:** Visitor Parking is with Honk Mobile M-F $3/hour up to $12 maximum per session.

### West Campus (Lot U) - Student Lot

**Location:** Off of Brescia Drive.

**Type of permit required:** All active Western parking permits.

**Visitor parking:** Visitor Parking is with Honk Mobile M-F $3/hour up to $12 maximum per session.

**Weekend parking:** Complimentary except when special event rates apply.

### Chemistry Lot (Lot Q) - Grey Employee Lot

**Location:** off Perth Drive, across from Chemistry Building.

**Type of permit required:** Employee permits any time. Student permits are permitted after 4 pm until 7 am, Monday - Friday and on the weekend.

**Visitor parking:** This lot is permit parking only; no paid visitor parking.

**Helpful advice:** From September - June, weekdays, this lot fills to capacity and remains full until 4 pm. Overflow can park at Westminster Hall (Lot B). Do not park in "reserved spaces" or hash-lined areas.

### Elborn College (Lot X) - Grey Employee Lot

**Location:** west side of Western Road, north of Sarnia Road, near Elborn College.

**Type of permit required:** Employee permits at any time. 

**Visitor parking:** Complimentary from Monday - Friday, after 4 pm until 7 am, and all day Saturday/Sunday. Some Honk Mobile spaces are available in this lot (signed Honk Mobile spaces only) available for paid visitor parking during business hours.

**Helpful advice:** From September - April, weekdays, this lot fills to capacity. Overflow can park at Springett (Lot I) or Huron Flats (Lot S).

### Huron Flats (Lot S) - Student Parking

**Location:** east of Western Road, near Essex Hall and Thompson Recreation Centre.

**Type of permit required:** All active Western parking permits.

**Visitor parking:** Visitor Parking is with Honk Mobile M-F $3/hour up to $12 maximum per session.

**Weekend parking:** Complimentary except when special event rates apply.

**Helpful advice:** From October - April, during the week, this lot does not fill to capacity. In September this lot usually fills to capacity due to scheduled events at Alumni Stadium. Overflow can park at Medway (Lot R).

### Kent Drive Lot (Lot A) - Clinic Patient and Employee Reserved lot

**Location:** off Lambton Drive, near 3M Center.

**Patients of Fowler-Kennedy Clinic:** Monday - Friday, 7 am - 5 pm, $8 Flat Rate. 

**Type of permit required:** This is a reserved patient lot during business hours.

**Visitor parking:** Monday - Friday, 5 pm - 7 am $3/hour up to $8 daily rate.

**Weekend parking:** Complimentary except when special event rates apply.

**Helpful advice:** Do not park in "reserved spaces" - this includes Fowler Kennedy reserved patient spaces (7 am - 6 pm).

### Lambton (Lot L) - Orange Employee Lot

**Location:** off Wellington Drive at Western Road, just north of the Support Services Building.

**Type of permit required:** Employee Orange permits at any time. All active Employee and Student permits permitted after 5 pm until 7 am.

**Weekend parking:** Complimentary except when special event rates apply.

**Honk Mobile Spaces:** Located on the south side of the Lambton Hall Residence for short term visits ($1.50 per half hour).

**Helpful advice:** from September - April, weekdays, this lot fills to capacity. Overflow can park at Springett (Lot I). Do not park in "reserved spaces".

### Medical Science (Lot C) - Dental Patient Lot

**Location:** off Elgin Drive, beside the Medical Sciences Building.

**Dental Clinic Patients:** 7:00 am - 5:00 pm Monday - Friday, $1.50 per half hour up to $8 maximum.

**Off-campus dental clinicians:** clinicians have access when lot attended (Monday - Friday, 7 am - 5:00 pm).

**Visitor parking:** Monday - Friday, 5:00 pm - 7:00 am $3/hour up to $8 daily maximum rate.

### Medway (Lot R) - Student Lot

**Location:** north of University Drive, across from Sydenham Hall.

**Type of permit required:** All active Western parking permits.

**Visitor parking:** Visitor Parking is with Honk Mobile M-F $3/hour up to $12 maximum per session.

**Weekend parking:** Complimentary except when special event rates apply.

**Honk Mobile Spaces:** Located in front of the residences for short term visits, $1.50 per half hour.

**Helpful advice:** from September - April, during the week, this lot does not fill to capacity.

### Middlesex (Lot G) - Orange Employee Lot

**Location:** off Perth Drive, behind Middlesex College, behind the Greenhouses.

**Type of permit required:** Employee orange permits valid at any time. No visitor parking M-F during the day.

**Visitor parking:** Monday - Friday, after 4 pm until 7 am, complimentary for patrons of The Grad Club. 

**Weekend parking:** Complimentary except when special event rates apply.

**Paystation :** located across the street between the North Campus and Visual Arts buildings for short term visits, $1.50 per half hour.

**Helpful advice:** from September - April, during the week, this lot usually fills to capacity. Please observe RESERVED spaces - authorized use ONLY.

### Ontario (Lot N) - Student Lot

**Location:** west side of Western Road, south of Sarnia Road, at Althouse College by Ontario Hall Residence.

**Type of permit required:** All active Western permits. There is no paid visitor parking in this lot.

**Weekends:** Parking is complimentary.

### Siebens (Lot W) - Orange Employee Reserved Lot

**Location:** entrance off Western Road, north of Elgin Drive.

**Type of permit required:** M-F this lot is reserved for Employee Orange Reserved Permits and registered SPARC patients only. 

**Weekend parking:** Complimentary except when special event rates apply.  


### Social Science (Lot J) - Visitor & Reserved Employee Permit Lot

**Location:** off Elgin Drive, behind the Social Science Center.

**Type of permit required:** M-F 7 am - 5 pm Employee Orange Reserved permits only. After 5 pm until 7 am all other valid Western Permits eligible for entry.

**Visitor parking:** Visitor Parking Monday to Friday is $1.50 per half hour forb up to two hours. After two hours the rate is $21 maximum per session.

**Weekend parking:** Complimentary in the visitor spaces only, except when special event rates apply.

**Helpful advice:** After 5 pm, all permits can access this lot in the _visitor area only_. Do not park in "reserved spaces".

### South Valley (Lot P) - Grey Employee Lot

**Location:** off Huron Drive.

**Type of permit required:** Employee active permits at any time. Student permits are allowed to park in this lot after 9:30 am until 7 am. Student permits in the lot between 7 am and 9:30 am will may be ticketed. 

**Visitor parking:** M - F, 4 pm - 7 am and weekends - Paid via Honk Mobile, up to $18 maximum. Visitors must vacate the lot by 7 am M - F.

**Weekend parking:** Complimentary except when special event rates apply.

**Honk Mobile Spaces:** located near the Health Sciences Building for short term visits, $1.50 per half hour.

**Helpful advice:** please observe RESERVED spaces - authorized use ONLY.

### Springett (Lot I) - Employee and Student Permit Lot

**Location:** west side of Western Road, near Huron College food court.

**Type of permit required:**

_Employee grey lot:  
_ Active Employee permits at any time. All other active Western permits after 4 pm only.

_Student green lot:  
_ All active Western permits at any time.

  


**Visitor parking:** M - F, 4 pm - 7 am - pull ticket to pay by credit card at rate of $1.50 per half hour up to $18.00 maximum. The daily rate for the student lot will remain at $12. 

  
**Helpful advice:** please observe RESERVED spaces - authorized use ONLY. Student green zone lot fills to capacity by 9 am during the academic year.

**Weekend parking:** Complimentary except when special event rates apply.

### Support Services Lower Lot (K) - Employee Lot

**Location:** behind the Support Services building off Western Rd.

**Type of permit required:** Employee Orange Reserved (CRK) permits.

**Visitor parking:** at Honk Mobile signed spaces ONLY at these times: 7 am until 8 pm. No visitor parking in this lot 8 pm - 7 am.

**Helpful advice:** no overnight parking in this lot.

### Support Services Upper Lot - Visitor Lot

**Location:** on the south side of the Support Services building off Western Rd.

**Type of permit required:** Service Vehicle Permits in signed spaces only.

**Visitor parking:** at Honk Mobile signed spaces ONLY at these times: 7 am until 8 pm. No visitor parking in this lot 8 pm - 7 am.

**Helpful advice:** no overnight parking in this lot.

### Talbot (Lot F) - Orange Employee Lot

**Location:** intersection of University Drive and Huron Drive, across from Talbot College.

**Type of permit required in Orange area:** Orange Employee permits at any time. Campus tour patrons with a QR code can park in the gated section. M - F. After 4 pm to 7 am, all active Western permits are permitted.

**Visitor parking:** Pay Station/Honk Mobile area available for short term visitor parking is located in the south (ungated) part of this lot, $1.50 per half hour.

**Weekends:** The Orange Core Lot is complimentary on weekends.

**Helpful advice:** please observe RESERVED spaces and signage - these areas are for permit holders only.

### Upper Heating (Lot E) - Orange Employee Reserved Lot

**Location:** off Lambton Drive, near Alumni Hall.

**Type of permit required:** Employee Orange Reserved "CRE" Permits and registered Fowler Kennedy patients at any time in their respective signed spaces.

**Complimentary parking:** Complimentary from Monday - Friday, after 7 pm until 7 am, and all day Saturday/Sunday.

**Helpful advice:** please observe RESERVED spaces - authorized use ONLY.

### Visual Arts (Lot Y) - Orange Employee Lot

**Location:** off Perth Drive, near Labatt Visual Arts Building.

**Type of permit required:** Employee Orange permits only, 7 am to 7 pm. No overnight parking permitted.

**Visitor Parking:** Honk Mobile area**** nearby**** located between the Labatt Visual Arts Building and North Campus Building for short term visits, $1.50 per half hour.

### Weldon - Visitor Lot 

**Location:** off Lambton Drive, near Weldon Library

**Visitor parking through Honk Mobile:** rate is $1.50 per half hour, no daily maximum.

### Westminster (Lot B) - Student Lot

**Location:** at the intersection of Windermere and Richmond Roads.

**Type of permit required:** All active Western parking permits.

**Weekend parking:** Complimentary except when special event rates apply.

**Visitor Parking:** Short-term paid visitor parking by Honk Mobile or Pay Station, located in the area for short term visits ($1.50 per half hour) - 24 hours. Please watch for signs indicating Visitor Parking Spaces.

**Helpful advice:** this lot usually fills to capacity.

# Service Vehicle Parking

Western Service Vehicles can park in signed Service Vehicle spaces, as well as any regular permit or visitor space.

**Service vehicles may not be park in fire routes or reserved spaces.**

Click on a lot/area name to find the location of Service Vehicle parking spaces.

### Alumni/Thompson (Lot M) - Visitor Lot

Service Vehicles spaces are located on the side of the lot closest to Huron College.

### Bayfield and Ausable Hall Residences Area

Service Vehicles spaces are located on the side of the lot closest to Huron College.

### B & G Greenhouses 

Service vehicle spaces are located along the south side of the lot facing the building.

### Essex Hall 

Service vehicle spaces are located along the south side of the lot facing the building.

### Ivey Lot

Service vehicle spaces are located along the south side of the lot facing the building.

### Lambton Lot (L)

Service vehicle spaces are located on the South side of the Lambton Residence.

### Medical Science Lot (C)

Service vehicle spaces are located along the south side of the building near the accessible spaces.

### Ontario Hall Lot (N)

Service vehicle spaces are located along the south side of the lot facing the building.

### Support Services Lot (K)

Service Vehicles spaces are located on the side of the lot closest to Huron College.

### University Drive

Service vehicle spaces are located along the south side of the lot facing the building.

### Upper Heating

Service vehicle spaces are located along the south side of the lot facing the building.

### Visual Arts

Service vehicle spaces are located along the south side of the lot facing the building.

# Summer, Evening & Weekend Parking Options

### Evening Parking

  * **Complimentary parking** is available in the evenings from 4:00 pm - 7:00 am in the Elborn Lot and from 7:00 pm - 7:00 am in the Visual Arts and Upper Heating lots (please do not park in metered or reserved spaces).
  * Parking is available in most gated, unattended lots between 6:00 pm - 6:00 am at a rate of $1.50 per half hour to a maximum of $7.00 - payment by credit card on exit.



### Weekend Parking Options

### Complimentary Parking

Friday at 8:00 pm to Monday at 6:00 am complimentary parking is available at:

  * Alumni Thompson Visitor Parking lot (excluding event days)



Friday at 7:00 pm to Monday at 6:00 am complimentary parking is available at:

  * Upper Heating
  * Visual Arts
  * Siebens



Friday at 5:00 pm to Monday at 6:00 am complimentary parking is available at:

  * Springett Student
  * Springett Staff
  * Medway lot behind Elgin Hall Residence
  * Huron Flats



Friday at 4:00 pm to Monday at 6:00 am complimentary parking is available at:

  * Elborn College - regular lot spaces
  * Talbot Staff - gated lot



### [Gated Lots - pay by credit card](../not_published/Permit_Visitor_Parking_Lots_OFF_SEASON2.html)

Social Science Visitor lot is available for parking at in the non-reserved spaces. Payment is made at the exit by credit card. The rate is $1.50 per half hour up to the two hour mark. After two hours, the daily maximum rate of $21.00 is charged.

*Please note that some lots will be unavailable at times due to special events or closed for the winter season.

### Honk Mobile (No Maximum Rate)

Located at various buildings in the campus core and where ever there is Pay & Display parking.

Rates are as posted ($1.50 per half hour) 24 hours a day and 7 days a week. *NOTE EXCEPTION: no parking at Support Services (Lot K) Honk spaces from 8 pm - 7 am. 

### Pay & Display (Multi-space Meter Parking)

Located at:

  * Brescia Circle
  * Essex/London Hall
  * Faculty of Education
  * Labatt Health Science Building
  * Medical Science Bldg.
  * Music Bldg.
  * North Campus Bldg.



  * Ontario Hall
  * Support Services Building
  * Talbot College
  * Westminster Hall



Rate: $1.50 per half hour - 24 hours a day, 7 days a week

Credit Card minimum: $1.50 (Visa, Visa Debit, Mastercard and American Express are accepted).

[ ](/find/visitor/coin_entry_winter)

### Summer Parking

Parking access on campus remains the same during the summer months. Please review the [individual lot details](map.html) for information.

The parking office also has a student summer term pass available. This permit allows students to park in a variety of lots on campus including all day (24hrs/day, 7 days/week) access to:

  * Althouse Student Lot
  * West Campus Lot
  * Huron Flats Lot
  * Westminster



  * Medway Lot
  * Springett Student Lot
  * South Valley   
(after 9:30am)



The Student Summer permit also allows limited access (after 4:00 pm, Mon-Fri) to some campus core lots. See the [Parking map](map.html) for lot locations or contact the Parking Office for additional information.

# Sustainable Transportation

Western University supports environmentally and economically sustainable forms of transportation including:

#### [**Bicycles**](bicycles.html)

There are close to 350 bicycle racks strategically located on campus. A Bike Shelter and lockers are also available for renting.

  * [Learn More](bicycles.html)[](carpooling.html)



#### [**London Transit**](http://www.ltconline.ca/)

Several city buses travel through Western's campus. Schedules and routes can be found on London Transit's website.

  * [Learn More](http://www.ltconline.ca/)



**NEW!** Western offers 37 Electric Vehicle Charging Stations on campus - [LEARN MORE](../../services/ev_charging_stations.html).

# Visitor Parking

There is no complimentary parking on campus during the week Monday to Friday, 7 am to 5 pm. Evening and weekend complimentary parking locations can be found under [Summer, Evenings and Weekends](../summer_evening_weekend.html). Visitors and invited guests should be directed to one of our available visitor attended lots, Honk Mobile areas, or Pay & Display metered areas. All parking on campus is restricted to lots/spaces that have been designated for various permits, etc. The University campus is private property; valid permits or paid meter receipts must be visible on your dashboard.

#### [**Attended Lot Visitor Parking**](attended.html)

Credit card payment only.

  * [See Rates & Locations](attended.html)



#### [**Permit/Visitor Lots**](permit_visitor_parking_lots.html)

Visitors are required to pay by credit card based on time in a lot.

  * [See Rates & Locations](permit_visitor_parking_lots.html)



#### [**Honk Mobile/Pay & Display**](metered.html)

No daily maximum cost. Pay & Display Units accept Visa, MasterCard, Amex and Visa Debit as well as coin ($2, $1 and quarters).

  * [See Rates & Locations](metered.html)



  


### Student Residence - Guest Parking 

Overnight guests of students in residence should park in a paid Visitor Lot, Pay and Display or Honk Mobile area, or may be able to take advantage of free overnight parking on the weekends in the [Huron Flats](../map.html) parking lot.

# Visitor Parking Payments

**Accepted Forms of payment at Western Parking gates – Amex, MasterCard and Visa.**

**DEBIT/TAP IS NOT ACCEPTED**

Customers utilizing visitor parking spaces are expected to have an acceptable method of payment. Customers wishing to pay by coin should use the Pay and Display machines located across campus. See the [**PARKING MAP**](../map.html) for Pay and Display locations.

When payment cannot be made at the gate, a Customer Service Representative may take customer information so that a fee can be collected later and the parker can be on their way. While making payment later may be convenient for customers, our parking gate system is not set up to efficiently and effectively take payments/information over the intercom; for this reason, an administrative fee is charged on all non-payment transactions.

**When you have failed to make payment at the time of parking:**

  * it is the customer’s responsibility to reach out to the Parking Office if needed, and to clear up outstanding parking fees
  * gate parking charges are not eligible for appeal

# Academic Seals

Students who incur parking infractions are encouraged to [pay](pay.html) or [appeal](appeals/index.html) tickets, as appropriate, within 14 days. Students with outstanding accounts run the risk of having their academic records sealed.

It is the student's responsibility to ensure that all fees are paid. Students may view their account balance online at <https://westernu.t2hosted.ca/Account/Portal>.

Outstanding accounts may be refereed to a collection agency. The University's collection agency will protect all personal information in its possession or control in accordance with all applicable privacy and data protection laws. Failure to make payment in full by the due date on the statement of account or arrange a deferment will result in financial and academic sanctions. 

For more information, refer to the "[Academic Sanctions](https://westerncalendar.uwo.ca/PolicyPages.cfm?Command=showCategory&PolicyCategoryID=1&SelectedCalendar=Live&ArchiveID=#Page_13)" section of the Academic Calendar. 

### What does it mean to have academic records sealed?

When student records are "flagged" with an academic seal, the student will be unable to add or drop courses, or obtain a record of marks or transcripts. Additionally, students who convocate with an academic seal on their student account will not receive a physical copy of their Western diploma until such time as the account is in good standing.

### What is the process involving academic seals?

There is a $75 administrative fee associated with having your records sealed. Seal fees are not appealable. This means if your account goes unpaid, your full parking account balance must be paid off before an academic seal will be lifted from your account - this will include any unpaid tickets as well as seal fees or other service fees.

### How long does it take for the academic seal to be released once my account is paid? 

During business hours when the Parking Office is open, reports are run every hour to clear up accounts that have been paid off. If you pay your tickets online or at the counter during business hours, you can generally expect to have your academic seal lifted within an hour. Tickets paid online on the weekend will be unsealed on the next business day. At certain times of year or during other periodic office closures, it may take longer to have your records unsealed. In unforeseen circumstances it could take as long as one full business day for release of the academic seal.

### Why does Parking seal my student records for unpaid tickets?

Many Western departments (Libraries, Office of the Registrar, Student Health, Housing as well as Parking & Visitor Services) use academic seals to ensure timely attention to outstanding account balances. Chasing customers down for payment costs everyone time and money. Academic record seals are a standard practice at most Canadian universities.

# Appeal Infraction

**Please read the following information carefully before proceeding with your appeal.**

**Any use of offensive language in an appeal will result in the appeal being denied and will be reported to Western Special Constables, Human Resources, Student Conduct, And/Or Other Appropriate Venues.**

_A Ministry of Transportation Ontario vehicle search to identify ownership, if unknown, will be done 7 days after date of violation if the citation has not been paid or appealed, and a Service Fee will apply. Appeals will still be accepted within 14 days of the infraction date._

The decision of the [Appeals Committee](committee.html) is final and fines are considered due when the decision is rendered. Unfamiliarity with Western University's traffic and parking regulations does not constitute grounds for appeal.

  * **Appeals will not be reviewed if you have previously outstanding unpaid citations on your account**
  * **Appeal your ticket within 7 days of issuance to avoid incurring the $19 MTO search fee**
  * Appeals will not be processed without supporting documentation, if applicable
  * Any documentation can be uploaded with your online appeal
  * Photographs are taken with each citation



### Important Reminders

  
The following reasons are not considered grounds for an appeal:   
  


  * "Everybody parks there / I am the only one who got a ticket."
  * "I was only there for five or ten minutes."
  * "I've parked there for the last five weeks (months/years) and I've never been cited before."
  * "I didn't know."
  * "I thought it was a space."
  * "I didn't see the sign."
  * "I can't afford the fine."
  * "I had to use the washroom facilities (or had a sick friend that had to use the washroom facilities)."
  * "My permit/pass/parking receipt was not properly displayed because..."
  * "I parked on landscaping/hash lines/end of aisle/reserved space or ungated permit lot because there were no other spaces available."
  * "I have no Wifi or internet service."
  * "I paid for visitor parking after I recieved the citation"



### Service Fees

Service Fees/Admin Fees cannot be appealed - they include:  
  
**Vehicle Search Fee (MTO)** \- Ministry of Transportation search to determine vehicle ownership   
**Collection Fees** \- unpaid tickets may be sent to a collection agency  
**Towing Fee** \- determined by the towing company at time of tow  
**Vehicle Storage Fee** \- vehicles towed and not recovered after 24 hours will incur a daily storage fee   
**Academic Seal Fee** \- students with tickets which are unpaid after 30 days may have academic records sealed   
**Visitor Parking Fees** \- daily lot charges for visitor parking

### Fire Route, Tow Zone, Western Special Constable Service Tickets Etc.

Appeals for the following infractions,

  * Traffic tickets issued by Western Special Constable Service
  * Parked in an Accessible space
  * Parked illegally - e.g. parked in Fire Lane, Tow Zone

  
will be considered, however, due to the nature of these offenses, an appeal is often not successful.

### Administration of Appeals

As part of the appeal process, you may request an open hearing with the Appeals Committee. An open hearing provides you with the opportunity to review your appeal with the committee, in person. The committee is comprised of several members of the Western community who are not employees of Parking Services.

Schedules of committee members determine dates and times for open hearings.

If the appellant elects for an open hearing, and subsequently does not attend their open hearing, the citation will be upheld, the appeal will be dismissed, and there will not be an opportunity to re-appeal. Please respect the time given by committee members to hear an appeal, if requesting an open hearing.

Please see our [Appeals Committee](committee.html) page for further information.

### Writing Your Appeal

Tell us in your online appeal:

  * why you think the parking violation should be cancelled or varied
  * limit your appeal to the space provided in the online form (500 characters max)
  * attach any evidence that supports your case
  * Any use of offensive language in an appeal will result in the appeal being denied and will be reported to Western Special Constables, Human Resources, Student Conduct, And/Or Other Appropriate Venues.



### Appeal Results

Decisions surrounding parking violation appeals will be made at the discretion of the Manager of Parking and/or the Parking Appeals Committee.

The appellant will be notified of their appeal decision via email. Please ensure you are providing a valid and correct email address as a decision will be sent to this address within six weeks of submitting your appeal. Decisions are final and binding.

### Unsettled Parking Accounts

  
Outstanding fines are applied to accounts through vehicle license numbers. Registered owners of vehicles are traced through the Ontario Ministry of Transportation. The University may take action against persons found in default of fines through:   
  


  * withdrawal of parking privileges
  * towing of offending vehicles at owner's expense
  * sealing of student records
  * submission of account to a collection agency



### [Submit Appeal Online](https://westernu.t2hosted.ca/Account/Portal)

# Infractions

### [Pay Infraction](https://westernu.t2hosted.ca/Account/Portal)

Search by either your License Plate number or Citation/Transaction number and pay your citation online.

* * *

### [Appeal Infraction](appeals/index.html)

All parking infractions, with the exception of towing and service fees, may be appealed within fourteen days of the infraction date. Begin the appeal procedure now by completing the request form. [Learn More](appeals/index.html)

* * *

### [Academic Seals](academic_seals_and_sanctions.html)

Students who incur parking infractions which go unpaid may be subject to academic record seals. [Learn More](academic_seals_and_sanctions.html)

* * *

### [Towed Vehicles](towed_vehicles.html)

Unauthorized or improperly parked vehicles will be ticketed and towed at the owners' expense and liability. [Learn More](towed_vehicles.html)

* * *

### [Parking Regulations](regulations/index.html)

Purchase of any parking permit or day pass constitutes an agreement from the purchaser to abide to the University's Rules and Regulations. [Learn More](regulations/index.html)

# Parking Regulations

Remember that parking lots at the University are private property. Purchase of any parking permit or day pass constitutes an agreement from the purchaser to abide to the rules and regulations [](/infractions/pdf/rules_regulations.pdf)approved for the University community by the Board of Governors.

[1.37 Parking and Traffic Regulations](https://www.uwo.ca/univsec/pdf/policies_procedures/section1/mapp137.pdf)

  * [Procedures](https://www.uwo.ca/univsec/pdf/policies_procedures/section1/mapp137_procedure.pdf)

  


### [Parking Infractions](parking_infractions.html)

  * Issued by [Western Special Constable Service](http://www.uwo.ca/police/) as well as trained Parking Enforcement Staff



### [Traffic Infractions](traffic_infractions.html)

  * Issued by [Western Special Constable Service](http://www.uwo.ca/police/)



### Please do not ignore your parking ticket!

Accounts with unpaid fines run the risk of the following actions:

  * Parking privileges revoked
  * Academic records sealed
  * Vehicles towed
  * Account balance transfered to a collection agency

# Towed Vehicles

Unauthorized or improperly parked vehicles will be ticketed and may be towed at the owners' expense and liability. Park only in marked parking areas. Do not park in loading zones, roadways, fire routes, aisle ways, landscaped areas or other non-parking areas.

If you suspect that your car has been towed, please contact the [Parking Office](../about/contact_us.html) or [Western Special Constable Service](http://www.uwo.ca/police/).

  


All towing of vehicles at Western University is performed by a private contractor in accordance with City of London standards. Please be advised that **towing fees and applicable taxes are subject to change without notice**.

Procedure | Fee  
---|---  
Towing (service charge) | $160.00* plus HST  
  
* Towing Fee may be subject to fee increase due to method of towing and distance of the tow.

# License Plate Recognition (LPR)

Western Parking Enforcement is now utilizing LPR technology.

If you use Western's permit lots, you'll need to ensure your Parking Account is up to date with accurate information and that your vehicles plates are linked to your permit. 

Update your vehicle information on your account:

  1. Log in to our [Parking Portal](https://westernu.t2hosted.ca/Account/Portal) to manage your account.
  2. Click "LOGIN" in the upper right hand corner.
  3. Click on "Western University Login".
  4. Enter your username and password.
  5. You should receive a "Welcome" message in the top right corner if successful.
  6. Click on "Permits" in the top menu bar.
  7. Click on "View Your Permits".
  8. Click on the active permit for which you wish to add your vehicle (GNR/PNR/CNR etc.). _You DO NOT need to add it to the AVI Deposit_
  9. __On the "Permit Details" page you will see a list of "Associated Vehicles." If you do not see your vehicle then you will need to add your vehicle.__
  10. At the bottom, click on "Add Vehicles to Permit" button.
  11. Fill in all the blanks and click "Next" (If your particular "Model" is not listed please make sure "Style" is a good description of your vehicle).

  


_Once this is done, your vehicle should be on both your profile and your permit and is safe for License Plate Recognition parking in your eligible zones._

Please note:

  * You can only ADD new vehicle information to a parking account - if you have a vehicle you'd like removed from your parking account please email us the details at [wparking@uwo.ca](mailto:wparking@uwo.ca)
  * Any time there are changes to the status of your permit (i.e. expired permit renewal, switch of permit type, driving a new vehicle), you'll want to ensure your license plate is linked to your permit by completing these steps again.



## What is LPR?

LPR, License Plate Recognition technology uses optical character recognition to automatically read license plate characters. Western will be operating mobile LPR, which uses vehicle-mounted cameras to verify plates in all campus lots.

LPR will increase the accuracy of identifying unauthorized or unregistered vehicles parked on campus. With Western ID cards added for convenient lot entry, on-foot enforcement officers currently need to manually validate the license plate. This new technology automates the process and notifies parking staff of unauthorized vehicles.

The addition of LPR technology is the next phase in expanding the functionality and modernization of the recently installed T2 parking database and gating system. LPR is expected to improve enforcement efficiency and further protect permit holder rights.

### Frequently Asked Questions

### What is License Plate Recognition (LPR)?

License Plate Recognition is state of the art parking technology that uses optical character recognition to automatically read license plate characters. Western will be operating mobile LPR, which uses vehicle-mounted cameras to verify plates in all campus lots.

### Who else uses this technology?

This technology is being used by other campuses such as Mohawk College. London Police Services also uses LPR. 

### Why is Western using LPR?

With the increased volume of vehicles on campus it’s important for us to protect the space of paying permit holders. This new technology allows us to scan the campus quickly and effectively multiple times a day. 

### Why do I need to update the vehicle and license plate information on my account?

License plate recognition relies on information about your vehicle to ensure that the vehicle matches the permit being used. 

### What do I do about loaner or rental vehicles?

Loaner and rental vehicles need to be added to your account and linked to your permit. Once you return your loaned or rented vehicle, you can log back into your account and remove the vehicle. 

### How can I change and/or delete vehicle information on my account?

Our system allows you to update your account with new information and delete old information. If the vehicle you are trying to delete has a citation attached, you will not be able to delete it. If you require assistance please contact our office at wparking@uwo.ca.

### Are the images scanned by the cameras saved?

No, the images are not saved. Photos are taken by Western Enforcement Officers if a citation is written but no images are saved using LPR.

### Does the License Plate Recognition technology have access to Ministry of Transportation of Ontario (MTO) information?

No, neither the system itself nor the drivers of the vehicles have access to MTO information. The system simply looks for a match between the parking system and the license plate that it is looking at.

### What happened to the lot availability app?

It has been determined that the lot availability app is a risk to safe travel on campus. Parking & Visitor Services is now exploring other options for notifying our customers of availability in campus parking lots.

# How to Obtain an Accessible Western Parking Permit

### If you currently have a valid Western parking permit...

Bring your **Ministry of Transportation Accessible Parking Permit** and your **current permit hang tag** to [Parking and Visitor Services](../about/contact_us.html). We will exchange your employee/student permit for an accessible permit.

### If you do not have a Western Parking permit...

Bring your **Ontario Ministry of Transportation Accesible Parking Permit** and your **Western ONECard** to [Parking and Visitor Services](../about/contact_us.html) and we'll get you set up with an accessible permit.

### Permit Rates

Rates for an Accessible Permit are equivalent to the rate you would pay for a non-accessible permit, based on your [status on campus](index.html).

### Using Your Permit

Display your **Western Accessible hang tag** on your vehicle windshield. You may park at no further charge in any non-reserved parking space, Pay and Display area or Western Honk Zone. Do not park in spaces marked "Reserved." Please note that with a Western Accessible tag, University accessible space can be parked in as long as a provincial accessible permit is also on display.

  * [Find accessible spaces - Parking Map](../find/map.html)



### Temporary Disabilities

Core, Perimeter, and Undergraduate permit holders who require temporary accessible parking due to accident, injury, surgery, or similar occurrence may apply for accessible access on a temporary basis. Temporary permits are issued for a period of **eight weeks or less** while the Faculty/Staff member or Student is acquiring a provinical accessible permit.

  * **Employees** please contact [Western Employee Wellbeing](https://www.uwo.ca/hr/safety/well_being/index.html)
  * **Students** please contact [Accessible Education](https://academicsupport.uwo.ca/accessible_education/index.html)

# Commercial/Contractor

**Commercial Permits**

Commercial permits are sold on a monthly or annual basis and are available to commercial companies who conduct business on campus. It entitles the user to access any of the non-reserved spaces in any gated lot, at any meter or Pay and Display area, and 30 minutes in loading zones. Commercial firms may also use the parking facilities assigned to visitors (i.e. visitor lots, meters) and pay the stated rate.

The sale of a commercial permit must be approved in advance by both the FM Project Manager and the Manager, Parking Services. 

Commercial permits must be purchased in person at the [Parking Office](../about/contact_us.html).

**Contractor Permits**

Contractor permits are sold on a monthly or annual basis and are available for purchase by employees of companies conducting business on campus (eg; construction workers). Special parking areas are assigned to contractors by Western Parking Services. Contractors are prohibited from parking in all other areas.

Contractor permits must be purchased in person at the [Parking Office](../about/contact_us.html).

  * A parking permit is required for all vehicles parking on campus.   
  



  * Parking for contractors is only available in areas designated by Parking Services. Althouse/Ontario Student, Bayfield Hall, Huron Flats, Medway, Springett Staff, Westminster and West Campus parking lots are currently available for contractor parking.  
  

  * Laydown areas are not to be used for contractor parking. If contractors are permitted to park in laydown areas (advance approvals required from both Parking Services and FM Project Manager), a permit will still need to be purchased.  
  

  * Supervisor parking may be allowed closer to the project site, with Western approval. A commercial permit can be purchased and issued for these areas. ​These permits are typically limited to a maximum of 2 per contractor. Exceptions may be made if a company has multiple, active job sites on campus.   
  

  * Contractor vehicles cannot park in designated Western service vehicle spaces regardless of the type of parking permit held. Service vehicle spaces are for marked Western service vehicles only.



### Permit Rates

All rates include HST and are subject to change.

A fully refundable hang tag deposit of $30 will be charged at the Parking Office when picking up new permit hang tags.

***Rates for Sept 1, 2025 to August 31, 2026**

TYPE OF PERMIT | ANNUAL/MONTHLY  
---|---  
Commercial | $69.05/Month or $828.63/Year  
Contractor | $63.05/Month or $765.57/Year

# Employee Permits

#### [**Purchase/Renew Parking Permit**](https://westernu.t2hosted.ca/Account/Portal)

New Employee Permits require the purchase of a hang tag deposit ($30 refundable). These are not currently available for purchase online and must be picked up at the [Parking Office](../about/contact_us.html). 

### Rate Changes, September 2025

For the first time since September 2019, Western Parking Services will be adjusting permit rates to help sustain our services and invest in lot improvements. Starting September 1, 2025, there will be a 2% increase across all employee permit types.

### Permit Rates

If you are a student on campus who is also employed by Western (TA, RA, etc), your student status overrides any Employee status. Students in this position are eligible for a _**s**_ _**tudent**_ permit, not a Employee permit.

All rates include HST and are subject to change. When purchasing a permit, full-time employees are encouraged to use continuous monthly payroll deduction. Permits on payroll deduction will automatically be renewed each month so you will only need to contact the Parking Office to cancel your permit. Your permit will be valid for as long as you would like to have it.

**_It is the permit holder's responsibility to manage the start and end date of their permit._**

A fully refundable hang tag deposit of $30 will be charged at the Parking Office when picking up new permit hang tags.

**New to Employee Parking?**

We're happy to help! In-person service is available Mondays through Fridays (except holidays) from 8:30am until 4:00pm. You'll find us in room 4150 of the Support Services Building.

To make your set up as smooth as possible our team will need you to have your Western ID number, Western e-mail address, and vehicle information, ready. 

If you're nervous about your first day, we can help set up your parking permit prior to your start date to help you pre-plan. We'll just need the same information as above: Western ID number, Western e-mail address, and vehicle information.

**Rates for Sept 1, 2025 - August 31, 2026**

***Perimeter Lot** \- lot situated in the campus periphery.

****Reserved Parking** \- a limited number of reserved spaces in Core or Perimeter lots may be available to Employees and Students. Parking in a reserved section is authorized only for the vehicle(s) for which the reserved permit has been issued. Reserved permits are only valid in the lot requested. Reserved spaces cannot be 'loaned' to another person and/or vehicle. Holders of reserved permits may park in any space within the reserved section of their selected lot. Reserved permits are not oversubscribed. A premium rate is charged for this service.

******* **Core Lot** \- smaller lot situated in the campus core.

### Permit Unification Coming September 2026

The current differentiation between perimeter (grey) and core permits (orange) was established more than 30 years ago and campus has grown substantially over those years. To better reflect today’s campus, starting September 1, 2026, Parking Services will be eliminating Perimeter and Core permits and replacing them with two new permit types: Employee Reserved and Employee Non-Reserved. Rates for both will be set at the correlating Perimeter pricing, with a planned rate increase of 3% in 2026.

Here’s what this means for permit holders:

**Employee Non-Reserved** permit holders will be able to park in any non-reserved permit space—whether it was previously a Core or Perimeter lot.

**Employee Reserved** permit holders will continue with no change to designated reserved spaces in their currently assigned lot.

Further communications from Parking Services will be issued to permit holders in advance of this upcoming change during the summer of 2026.

# GSV Permits

General Service Vehicle (GSV) permits are available, with departmental approval, to facilitate deliveries and allow service access to university buildings. 

In order to obtain a General Service Vehicle (GSV) permit, _drivers must have a valid parking permit for the current academic year._

All passes are issued electronically and linked to valid paid permits. Passes will not be issued to vehicles without a permit. Commercial vehicles requiring General Service Vehicle (GSV) passes will require commercial hang tags.

Employee and Commercial vehicles using General Service Vehicle (GSV) permits MUST also display a valid paid Western parking hang tag.

Permit Type | Description | Annual Cost  
---|---|---  
General Service Vehicle (GSV) permit |  GSV permits are "virtual." No hang tag is issued. Valid Employee/Commercial permit must be displayed. Valid at Honk Mobile spaces, Pay & Display areas, loading zones, service ramps and non-reserved parking spaces for 60 minutes. GSV permits expire at the end of the academic year and must be renewed annually. | $30 each  
  
***All zones are monitored regularly by Parking enforcement staff.**

As a guideline, Parking Services asks that General Service Vehicle (GSV) permits only be requested for individuals who require frequent access to these service/restricted areas.

_Please note: Abuse of these permits affects the functionality of these areas and disrupts timely servicing of equipment, removal of garbage and delivery of material. In order to prevent such disruptions, Parking Services reserves the right to withdraw permits that are used improperly._

[**REQUEST FORM - GENERAL SERVICE VEHICLE PERMITS**](LZ-GSV-Letter-2025.pdf)

**Print off the request form then send completed form to:[wparking@uwo.ca](mailto:wparking@uwo.ca)**

# Western Parking Permits

To learn about permit rates and renewal procedures, please select the category below that matches your status on campus. 

* * *

#### [Employee](faculty_staff.html)

If you are employed and paid by Western University. This does not include registered students who are employed on a part-time basis.

* * *

#### [Students – undergraduates, professional students and graduate students](students/index.html)

If you are a registered student in an undergraduate program at Western, or if you are a registered student who is studying a Master's, PhD, or other authorized graduate degree at Western.

* * *

#### [Accessible](accessible.html)

If you are a Ministry of Transportation Accessible Parking Permit holder. Consideration may also be given to those with a temporary accessibility issue.

* * *

#### [Retirees](retirees.html)

If you are a retired employee of Western University who requires access to parking on campus.

* * *

#### [Commercial/Contractor](commercial.html)

If you are a commercial company, vendor, or contractor who visits Western University regularly to conduct business.

* * *

#### [General Service Vehicle](gereral_service_vehicle.html)

If you are a Western Faculty or Staff person with a paid permit, you may be able to get approval for a GSV permit with departmental approval.

* * *

#### [Other Permits](other.html)

If you do not fall into any of the categories listed here and require University parking privileges.

# Other Permits

If you fall into one of the following categories, you will not have a Western ID Card and will need to visit the [Parking Office](../about/contact_us.html) to purchase or renew a parking permit:

  * YMCA - Daycare
  * Construction/Onsite Subcontractor (accessible at [Huron Flats, Westminster and Medway Lots](../find/map.html))



Please bring identification along with your vehicle plate information in order to set up a parking account.

### Motorcycle Permits

Motorcycle parking permits are available to any student or university employee. If you have already purchased a current parking permit, motorcycle permits are issued at no charge otherwise the current rate is charged.

Motorcycle permits are only issued annually and ownership is required at the time of purchase.

***Rate for Sept 1, 2023 to August 31, 2024**

Type of Permit | Annual Fee  
---|---  
Motorcycle/Scooter/Moped | $114.72  
  
*All rates include HST and are subject to change.

### Loading Zone Permits

30 minute loading zone permits may be obtained by faculty staff with active parking permits. Please contact the Parking Office for information at: [wparking@uwo.ca](mailto:wparking@uwo.ca)

### Medical and Dental Clinician Permits

The permits for Medical and Dental Clinicians will be provided in accordance with lists supplied by the Deans' Offices and will be issued by the Manager of Parking & Visitor Services.

# Retirees

**Available only to Western's Retired Employees.**

Please email wparking@uwo.ca for information on how to obtain a new retiree parking permit.

*Retirees are issued a complimentary permit which authorizes parking in the [Alumni/Thompson lot](../find/map.html "See Parking Map") at any time (as space permits), any [Honk parking](../find/visitor/metered.html) space on campus (as space permits) and all gated lots after 4 pm and ungated lots after 7 pm Monday to Friday, all day Saturday, Sunday, and Statutory Holidays (posted signage at lot entrances may restrict parking and should be obeyed). **Retiree parking permits are not valid at affiliated colleges.**

A fully refundable hang tag deposit of $30 will be charged at the Parking Office when picking up new permit hang tags. 

If you currently have a retiree permit, you no longer need to renew your permit each year. Your permit will be valid for as long as you would like to have it.

Retiree permits are a benefit to the retiree and can only be used by the retired employee member it is assigned to. Active students and employees are not eligible to use retiree permits. 

*Retirees - Retired members of UWO Faculty may apply for complimentary visitor area parking (depending on space availability).

# Student Parking Permits

If you are a student on campus who is also employed by Western (TA, RA, etc.), your student status overrides any Employee status. Students in this position are eligible for a student permit, not an Employee permit.

Student permits can be purchased online once you've set-up a Parking Account. Click on the 'Need Help?' section on the bottom left of this page for help with creating your Parking Account.

**Student permits are limited and are sold based on available space. We encourage students living in residence or close to campus to forego bringing a vehicle to campus.**

_Students are reminded that purchasing Parking Permits through any third-party source (Kijiji, TikTok, Facebook Marketplace etc.) is contrary to Parking Regulations and students could be held responsible for any tickets associated with the permit they are using. Additional sanctions against their Western Parking Account could also apply._

Western Parking Permits should be purchased online here when available:

**The Fall 2025 (September 1st to December 31st) and Annual 2025/26 (September 1st 2025 to August 31st 2026) Student Parking Permits are sold out as of July 4 2025.**

The next available Student Parking Permits which will be available for sale will be for the Winter Term (Jan 2026 – Apr 2026) and are scheduled to be available for sale on November 15 2025.

We will be running a waitlist for the Annual and Fall Term Student Parking Permits and movement on the waitlist will directly depend on how many of the Annual and Fall Term Student Parking Permits which were sold are returned to the parking office. 

If you would like to be added to the waitlist, please select the [following link](https://uwo.eu.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_3aBbjolcUgkVyXY).

**Hang-tags can also be picked up early at the Parking Office during normal operating hours.**

#### [**Purchase a Parking Permit**](https://westernu.t2hosted.ca/Account/Portal)

### Student Parking Zones

Parking permits are not sold by lot; they are sold by zone. Students occupy the [green zone](../../find/map.html "See Parking Map"), which is comprised of:

  * Althouse West (**Tip:** fills to capacity by about 10:00 am) 
  * Bayfield Student Lot
  * Clare Hall Lot
  * Ontario Hall Student Lot
  * Medway (**Tip:** does not usually fill to capacity)
  * Huron Flats (**Tip:** fills to capacity in September because of football)
  * Springett Student Lot (**Tip:** fills to capacity by about 8:30 am) 
  * West Campus Lot
  * South Valley Lot - student permits can park in the South Valley Lot between the hours of 9:30 am and 7 am the next day. GNR/Student permits must not be in the lot between the hours of 7 am and 9:30 am (M-F) in the morning, to prioritize employee parking. 
  * Westminster Student Lot  


  


Periodically student permit holders are given access to additional parking lots on a temporary basis due to special events and construction on campus. Permit holders are asked to obey posted signage as lot access schedules are subject to change.

### Permit Rates

All rates include HST and are subject to change.   
A fully refundable deposit of $30 is required with new permit hang tags.

  
***Rates for September 1, 2022 to August 31, 2026 are listed below.**

TYPE OF PERMIT | TERM | ANNUAL  
---|---|---  
Student Green Non-Reserved **\- Annual and Fall - SOLD OUT** | $306.26 | $612.51  
Student Accessible  | $306.26 | $612.51  
Note: the annual permit includes the summer term at no charge.  
Casual Student Parking  
1 Month Permit **(Available for sale during the Summer Term in office and valid for only summer months)** | $76.57  
Other Fees  
Hang Tag Refundable Deposit | $30.00  
  
Even as one of Canada's largest Universities, Western's parking areas are limited and must be shared by upwards of 500,000 people annually. Possession of a permit does not guarantee a spot in a favourite lot. We ask that you respect the University's parking [rules and regulations](../../infractions/regulations/index.html) or consider other [sustainable transportation options](../../find/sustainable/index.html).

### Student Permit Refund Policy

### Administration Fee on Permit Refunds 

There are no administrative fees for refunding student permits.

### Returning a Term or Annual Permit Early 

Students who purchase a term or annual permit and return the permit early will be charged the monthly rate for the period they held the permit for, and will no longer be eligible for the cost savings associated with the purchase of a term/annual permit.

### Cut Off Dates for Refund of Permits 

Students returning permits after the 1st of the month will be charged for that current month.

The last day for the return of a _fall term_ permit for partial refund is December 1st. 

The last day for the return of an _annual permit_ for partial refund is April 1st.

The last day for the return of a _winter term_ permit for partial refund is April 1st.

### Hang Tag Deposit 

The $30 hang tag deposit fee is always returned to customers with no outstanding balances on their parking account. Photo identification is required to obtain a refund.
